headlines.text: 2025 brought us this moment: Kyle Fletcher vs. Tomohiro Ishii fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.14 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In his first defense since dethroning Rhodes, Fletcher weathered Ishii's brutal chops to retain the TNT Championship.
On this day in 2023, Rob Van Dam made their first appearance under the AEW banner in a FTW Rules match against Jack Perry, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.82.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Wheeler Yuta vs. Rocky Romero crossed paths for the first time ever on Rampage, rated 6.75.
